findings_for_codex.title: close_shared_account owner rent component has no deliverability preflight
findings_for_codex.detail: Both M8 workers flagged independently: the owner component of a page's rent is credited to the recorded owner_refund destination with validate_destination only; a sub-rent-exempt component to a fresh or rent-paying destination would fail the transaction under the cluster rent rule (LiteSVM cannot show it for data-less accounts). Consequence: that page (and its sponsor component) stays unclosable until the destination is funded; no lamports are lost and cleanup is never a precondition for commit, finalize or open. Options: (a) accept and document; (b) defer the owner component into the settled close's locked_owner_remaining when undeliverable (same mechanism as IMPL-43; needs a Codex decision because it changes DR-13 wording).
findings_for_codex.status: open for Codex; no code change made

findings_for_codex.title: A build_candidates batch that straddles a candidate-page edge fails as PageNotProvisioned
findings_for_codex.detail: BuildCandidates carries one candidate page per set, so the keeper must size each batch to stay inside one page of BOTH sets (up to 8 rows otherwise). A straddle is refused fee-only with PageNotProvisioned 6035 (close.rs build_batch), which misnames the condition. Keepers should batch at page edges; the M11 keeper documentation must say so, and a dedicated code could be appended later (frozen codes are append-only). No cash impact; the build is retryable with aligned batches.
